authoring: Authored FAQ-grounded single and compound queries, no independent human review or user traffic.
references: Original reviewed bilingual FAQ documents, paired by stable topic; both original references returned separately, never a synthesized evidence quote.
fitting: Original v1 TRAIN only; four convex 8-weight pairwise SGD fits: lr .05/.15 x seeds42/97, batch16 queries, L2 .01 toward uniform, max80 epochs patience10, at most8 hard negatives/query, gradient cap5. Projection to nonnegative simplex. Calibration on original CAL only.
selection: DEV top1 then MRR, language floor against old lexical; include LEGACY/TITLE/RRF/UNIFORM zero-learned-parameter controls. Calibrate minimum/margin/coverage by correct minus3*wrong. Export before fresh and old observed scoring.
metrics: Primary top1/MRR, all-primary-at3, nDCG@3 with primary relevance2 and secondary1, selective acceptances and refusal; accepted document is not task completion.
